selection_rule.ranking: most full solves, then prefer piece_list_json on ties
selection_rule.reasoning_probe: Qwen only, one predetermined development puzzle per stratum; exploratory and ineligible for protocol selection

scoring: Full official solver sequence, first mismatch stops; no alternate-line adjudication
context: Independent current-position request at every solver turn; no cross-puzzle history
assistance: Both conditions enforce JSON/UCI syntax; legal_choices_json also lists and constrains output to the legal move set. No engine scores or solutions supplied.
readiness_note: Selection thresholds are operational pilot checks, not proof of statistical power. Fresh evaluation happens once without changing the selected condition.
